name: OK-03
label: Safe R

key_factors: Deeply Republican district with a PVI of R+23
Long-serving incumbent Frank Lucas running for reelection with a large cash advantage
Democratic challenger Suzie Byrd has reported minimal fundraising
Prediction markets price Lucas at roughly 96% to win
model.rationale: This western Oklahoma seat is one of the most Republican districts in the country, and Frank Lucas has held it for decades with strong name recognition and over $500,000 on hand. With no polls, no expert ratings, and a challenger showing little fundraising activity, the fundamentals point to an easy Lucas win.
model.watch: Any sign of Lucas retirement, health trouble, or an unexpectedly well-funded challenger would be the main way this race could tighten.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Frank Lucas is a decades-long incumbent in a western Oklahoma district that leans Republican by more than twenty points, making this one of the safest House seats in the country for the GOP. He enters the general election with a substantial financial edge, having raised over $900,000 and holding more than $500,000 on hand, while Democrat Suzie Byrd has reported little visible fundraising activity.

Prediction markets give Lucas roughly a 96 percent chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the race as competitive. The district's partisan lean, the incumbency advantage, and the money gap all point the same direction. Barring an unexpected development, Lucas is positioned for an easy reelection.
